name: music_voices
description: Listening test: cycle through different SiON voices on the same melody
script: announce VOICE TESTS — same melody, different instruments
strudel c4 e4 g4 c5 cps=0.5
strudel c4 e4 g4 c5 s=flute cps=0.5
strudel c2 ~ c2 ~ e2 ~ g2 ~ s=bass cps=0.8
strudel [c3 g3 c4 e4]*2 s=organ cps=0.5
strudel [c4 e4 g4 c5]*3 s=marimba cps=0.6
strudel [c4 e4 g4 c5]*4 s=saw cps=0.5
strudel c4 e4 g4 c5 s=trumpet cps=0.4
strudel c3 e3 g3 c4 e4 g4 c5 g4 s=harp cps=0.4
strudel c5 d5 e5 f5 g5 a5 b5 c6 s=celesta cps=0.5
notify {SCRIPT} "How did the voices sound?" ["Good","Issues","Broken"] {inspect} blocking
